ios.desc:
AppRaven allows you to get paid apps for free! It shows you a daily updated list of apps that are currently available at discounted price, so you will never miss nice app deals ever again!

AppRaven has over a million downloads and 150k users. It contains thousands of interesting app collections and honest user reviews. Discover the best apps, connect with people who share the same interests and recommend your favorite apps to each other. Make a wish list and AppRaven will notify you whenever the apps you want the most go on discount.

Get AppRaven now and enjoy thousands of paid apps for free!

AppRaven’s unique features:

Discover New Apps

• Check daily updated charts to get an overview of the most popular apps around you.
• Browse collections of apps created by other users and create your own.
• Sort apps by the categories that interest you the most.
• Watch your favourite sellers and get notified whenever they have a new release.
• Be the first to see newly released apps and the latest updates.

Save Money

• Check daily which apps are on sale to save time and money.
• Add games to your wish list directly from within the App Store using the share extension and get notified whenever they are on sale or updated.
• Track apps to see the history of price changes and updates.
• Get many paid games for free every day.

Join the Community

• Find people who love the same apps as you and share them together.
• Connect with friends and give recommendations to each other.
• Rate and comment on apps and sellers - your opinions matter.
• Reply to other users and give them an advice.

What are you waiting for? Get AppRaven now and join the community!

quotes.text:
AppRaven is my very first mobile application. I have been using many similar price tracking apps for Apple devices, like AppZapp and AppShopper, but none of them fulfilled my needs. So I decided to create one myself! AppRaven users can track their apps easily, create their own collections, save money on daily sales and price drops and recommend apps to each other. This is what makes AppRaven unique and I am very happy I can share my app with you! I have developed my first server in Java and learn Swift from scratch to make the client side. Any support or feedback from you is greatly appreciated. 
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1490607195

Thank you!
